title: Five things to do in South Florida this week
igCaption:
Five things this week, starting with Panthers Pink in the Rink.
Oct. 12-17, South Florida, $0 to sold out

Sources: NHL.com, Miami New Times

#MiamiEvents #SouthFlorida #ThingsToDoMiami #OnlyInDade

scenes.text: The Panthers host Pink in the Rink Saturday. Here are five things to do in South Florida this week.
Saturday, the Florida Panthers host their fifth annual Pink in the Rink night. The event is presented by Baptist Health Cancer Care and Promise Fund, and it lands on October seventeenth.
scenes.caption: Saturday, the Florida Panthers host their fifth annual Pink in the Rink night. The event is presented by Baptist Health Cancer Care and Promise Fund, and it lands on Oct. 17.

scenes.text: Monday, Michael Lewis talks about his new book, Blockers, at Coral Gables Congregational Church. Dave Barry moderates at seven p.m., and tickets run from zero to thirty dollars with a book included.
scenes.caption: Monday, Michael Lewis talks about his new book, Blockers, at Coral Gables Congregational Church. Dave Barry moderates at 7 p.m., and tickets run from $0 to $30 with a book included.

scenes.text: Tuesday, Katseye plays Kaseya Center at eight p.m. The show is sold out. The group recently made its Saturday Night Live debut and will headline the Victoria's Secret Fashion Show later this month. Sold-out crowd, but NEAR shows you who else made it in.
scenes.caption: Tuesday, Katseye plays Kaseya Center at 8 p.m. The show is sold out. The group recently made its Saturday Night Live debut and will headline the Victoria's Secret Fashion Show later this month. Sold-out crowd, but NEAR shows you who else made it in.

scenes.text: Wednesday, the Miami Heat host the Brooklyn Nets at Kaseya Center. Tipoff is seven thirty p.m. Tickets cost fifteen to three hundred sixty-one dollars for one of the final preseason games.
scenes.caption: Wednesday, the Miami Heat host the Brooklyn Nets at Kaseya Center. Tipoff is 7:30 p.m. Tickets cost $15 to $361 for one of the final preseason games.

scenes.text: Thursday, the Chewy Pack Walk starts at six p.m. at Chewy Bark Park on Ponce de Leon Boulevard. Admission is free with RSVP, and the costume contest includes Most Creative Costume and Best Pet Parent Duo.
scenes.caption: Thursday, the Chewy Pack Walk starts at 6 p.m. at Chewy Bark Park on Ponce de Leon Boulevard. Admission is free with RSVP, and the costume contest includes Most Creative Costume and Best Pet/Parent Duo.

scenes.text: Which one are you doing this week? And if you keep crossing paths with the same people at these spots without ever talking, NEAR is the app that shows you who they were.
